qualifier: beta-catenin destruction and TCF target gene transcription
name: Beta-catenin destruction and TCF target transcription in Wnt signaling
rationale: All members concern canonical Wnt signaling at the level of the AXIN/APC destruction complex and beta-catenin:TCF transcriptional control, whereas the confusables cover ligand secretion, FZD/LRP receptor and DVL steps.

core: Natural killer cell cytotoxicity and its regulation
qualifier: MHC class I and KIR recognition
name: NK cell cytotoxicity regulation by MHC class I–KIR recognition
rationale: Members cover NK (and cytotoxic T cell) killing, its positive and negative regulation, KIR-cluster and NK surface signatures and MHC class I/Ib peptide presentation, while confusables add T cell activation, proliferation and dendritic cell regulation.

qualifier: response to replication-blocking drugs and DNA-protein crosslinks
name: DNA replication under hydroxyurea and camptothecin stress
rationale: Members combine DNA replication initiation and mitotic replication with responses to hydroxyurea, camptothecin and protein-DNA crosslink repair, unlike confusables centred on telomeres, fork reversal, topology or checkpoint signaling.

qualifier: endocytic recycling and membrane tubulation
name: Endocytic recycling and endosomal membrane tubulation
rationale: Members share endocytosis, endosome organization, tubulation and recycling back to the plasma membrane, whereas confusables emphasise Golgi secretion, Golgi localization and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation.

qualifier: of proteins and translation machinery (diphthamide, hypusine, hydroxylation, selenocysteine)
name: Unusual amino acid modifications of proteins and translation machinery
rationale: Members are non-methyl residue modifications such as hydroxylation, oxidation, diphthamide on EEF2, hypusine on eIF5A, selenocysteine and wybutosine tRNA synthesis, distinguishing them from methylation, core translation and mitochondrial RNA confusables.

qualifier: heart rate, contractility and blood pressure
name: Catecholamine regulation of heart rate, contractility and blood pressure
rationale: Members link norepinephrine/epinephrine secretion control to heart rate, cardiac contraction force and arterial pressure, while confusables centre on alpha-2 adrenergic, adenylate cyclase inhibition and insulin-secretion signaling.

qualifier: ATF6/XBP1/CREB3 chaperone gene induction
name: ER unfolded protein response and chaperone gene induction
rationale: Members are ER-stress UPR arms (ATF6, IRE1-XBP1, ATF4, CREB3) inducing chaperones, with ER-stress translational control and beta-cell apoptosis, whereas confusables add mitochondrial UPR and HRI/GCN2 integrated stress responses.

qualifier: ABCA1-mediated apoA-I lipidation and phospholipid efflux
name: HDL assembly via ABCA1 phospholipid efflux to apoA-I
rationale: Members concern nascent HDL formation through ABCA1-driven phospholipid and cholesterol efflux onto apoA-I, while confusables cover lipoprotein remodeling, LXR-regulated efflux and foam cell formation.

qualifier: pre-rRNA cleavage with proliferation-associated co-expression modules
name: Pre-rRNA processing and ribosome assembly in proliferating cells
rationale: Half the members are pre-rRNA cleavage and cytosolic ribosome assembly, accompanied by inner cell mass proliferation and co-expression modules (chromatin, mitochondrial, RB1/BCL2L1, ubiquitination) of growing cells, unlike confusables centred on Pol I-III transcription, splicing or Fanconi repair.

qualifier: synapse pruning and dendritic spine remodeling
name: Microglial activation and synapse and dendritic spine remodeling
rationale: Members combine microglial proliferation, differentiation, migration and activation with synapse pruning, spine maintenance and amyloid-beta response, while confusables emphasise DAP12, apoptotic-cell clearance, reelin or astrocyte regulation.

qualifier: myocardial growth, proliferation and adaptation, with vascular smooth muscle
name: Cardiomyocyte growth, proliferation and differentiation with vascular smooth muscle
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy, regeneration and ventricular/atrial myocardium morphogenesis plus aortic and coronary smooth muscle development, while confusables add valves, septa, endocardium and conduction system.

qualifier: germ cell proliferation, migration and meiotic entry with Sertoli/Leydig cells
name: Germ cell development and seminiferous tubule formation
rationale: Members cover primordial germ cell migration, proliferation, death and meiosis activation together with Sertoli, Leydig and seminiferous tubule development, unlike confusables on sex determination, sperm structure, ovarian cycle or oocyte maturation.

qualifier: prophase/prometaphase, with cohesion release
name: Mitotic and meiotic chromosome condensation and cohesion release
rationale: Members are prophase/prometaphase chromosome condensation and its regulation plus negative regulation of cohesion and chromatin localization, whereas confusables concern cohesin loading, cohesion establishment, CENP-A deposition and nuclear envelope events.

qualifier: nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, kidney growth control
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and kidney growth control
rationale: Members concern nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, branching, ureter morphogenesis and regulation of renal proliferation, apoptosis and size, while confusables cover nephron tubule, renal vesicle and intermediate mesoderm stages.

qualifier: attenuation by RAS GAPs and negative feedback
name: RAS–ERK signaling attenuation by GAPs and negative feedback
rationale: Members center on SOS/SHC/IRS input into RAS-MAPK and its termination by RAS GAPs (NF1), ERK inactivation and feedback, including RAS/MAP2K mutants, while confusables emphasise RAF activation, PI3K/AKT or upstream RTKs.

qualifier: NGF-TRKA and NTF3-TRKC
name: NGF–TRKA and NTF3–TRKC neurotrophin receptor signaling
rationale: Members describe TRKA activation by NGF and NTRK3 signaling via RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, FRS2, ARMS, ERK5 and CREB, distinguishing them from TRKB/BDNF, p75NTR and generic MAPK confusables.

qualifier: dendritic spine and filopodium structural plasticity
name: Postsynaptic actin cytoskeleton and dendritic spine structural plasticity
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic actin, PSD maintenance, spine morphogenesis, filopodium assembly and receptor delivery to the postsynapse, while confusables add dendrite arborization, EPHB signaling and cell polarity.

qualifier: by PDGF, TGF-beta and YAP/TAZ mechanical cues
name: Fibroblast activation by PDGF, TGF-beta and mechanical cues
rationale: Members are mechanoresponsive YAP/TAZ fibroblast modules, PDGF response, fibroblast proliferation, SMAD2/3, TGF-beta2 and paracrine VEGF production, whereas confusables focus on extracellular matrix components, adhesion and PDGFR pathway regulation.

qualifier: with snRNA gene transcription
name: RNA polymerase III and snRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members are Pol III initiation, elongation and termination at type 1-3 promoters, tRNA and snRNA transcription by Pol II/III, distinguishing them from Pol I rRNA transcription and translation confusables.

qualifier: autophosphorylation and ERK activation
name: ALK and LTK receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to ERK
rationale: Members are MDK/PTN-ALK and LTK signaling, tyrosine autophosphorylation and ERK activation, while confusables center on PI3K/AKT, IGF1R/IRS or PDGF responses.

qualifier: axon-glia nodal and paranodal domain organization
name: Myelination and axon–glia nodal domain organization
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, oligodendrocyte and Schwann cell myelination, paranodal junctions, sodium channel clustering and neurofascin/L1/NrCAM-ankyrin interactions, unlike confusables on axon regeneration and glial fate or proliferation.

qualifier: store-operated calcium entry
name: Store-operated calcium entry and calcium sensing
rationale: Members concern store-operated channel activation, calcium detection and response, and calcium channel activity, while confusables address Na/Ca exchange, ER/ryanodine release and mitochondrial calcium.

qualifier: of nuclear substrate proteins
name: SUMOylation of nuclear substrate proteins
rationale: Members are SUMO conjugation to target classes (cofactors, chromatin, DNA repair/replication, nuclear envelope, RNA-binding proteins) plus Ran-mediated mitosis, whereas confusables cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 transfer and desumoylation.

qualifier: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport and SLC26 anion exchange
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and SLC26 inorganic anion exchange
rationale: Members are SLC12 chloride cotransporters and SLC26 exchangers with their channelopathies (Bartter, Gitelman, Pendred, chloride diarrhea) and iodide, sulfate and oxalate transport, unlike confusables on bicarbonate, sodium/proton exchange or aquaporins.

qualifier: FGFR1-4 ligand activation and FRS/SHC/PLCG/PI3K cascades
name: FGFR1–4 ligand activation and downstream signaling cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 isoform ligand binding, Klotho co-receptors, FRS/SHC/PLCG/PI3K cascades and activating point mutants, distinguishing them from other RTK families, oncogenic fusions and drug-resistance confusables.
